auszuege.business: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of various dairy products and health drinks in China. The company offers liquid milk, dairy beverages, milk powder, yogurt, frozen drinks, cheese, milk fat, and packaged drinking water. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Hohhot, China.

name: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co.
